motivation: Develop Chuggy itself in the same repository-native environment used by its maintainers.
acceptanceCriteria: The ticket-specific acceptance criteria are satisfied and the relevant repository checks pass.
constraints: Read CLAUDE.md and .chug/tasks/review-change.md before changing the repository.

instructions: Implement the requested change and add focused regression coverage.

`.chug/tasks/ci.sh` runs the gates the change affects and no others. While you work, the test file or the single gate in hand is enough. Run `ci.sh` once the change is complete; if a gate is red, fix it, run that gate until it is clean, and run `ci.sh` again. Report the work as passing only after a run of `ci.sh` that ends clean: a gate that could not run is not a pass.

You may hand bounded pieces of this work to subagents, and should where it saves time: a search across the tree, a mechanical edit repeated over many files, a first draft of tests for a module you have specified.
Give a clear piece that needs no judgement to Sonnet and one that needs reasoning to Opus, and brief each with what to do, which files, and what done looks like.

Keep the design, the integration and every gate run yourself: subagents share your working tree and its database, so only one of you runs a gate at a time, and what a subagent returns is unreviewed work until you have read it.
Read .chug/tasks/review-change.md and review the change exactly as that brief requires.
